summary: TELUS Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 interim financial statements and management discussion, including routine items such as restructuring costs, derivative instruments, long-term debt fair values, and performance share unit details. No special-situation transaction is present; the filing is a standard periodic report by a Canadian issuer under the multijurisdictional disclosure system. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring beyond ordinary cost line items, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or abrupt management changes. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; solely operational and financial reporting.
